faq.title: I received a notice/message on my phone regarding a postal item, what should I do next?
faq.content: The message received informs you about the arrival of a postal item at your address. To pick up the item, please present yourself with your identity document at the post office indicated in the message.

faq.title: How do I correctly pack a postal item?
faq.content:
Pack and seal the parcel in such a way that it does not pose a health risk to postal employees. This will help avoid the danger of injury to employees involved in processing the item.

Close the parcel in intact packaging (without cracks or tears) that corresponds to the weight, shape and nature of the contents, as well as the mode and duration of transport. The item must be in an easily handleable form.

Pack glass or fragile objects specially, placing them in a sturdy box filled with appropriate protective material.

Seal liquids and easily liquefiable substances in airtight containers. Place each container in sturdy boxes lined with appropriate protective material.

Dry powders and dyes, such as aniline blue, etc., are not permitted for transport except in metal boxes, placed in turn in sturdy boxes with absorbent and protective material between the two packages.

Seal fatty, hard-to-liquefy substances (ointments, soft soap, etc.) in a first package (box, cloth bag, plastic material).

faq.title: What documents must I present when picking up a postal item? Can another person pick up my item?
How can I redirect an item to another post office?
faq.content: To redirect mail from one post office to another, you need to submit a special request. This request can be submitted at any post office and is an auxiliary paid service.
